items.title: Branford Marsalis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I said, “You need to call Darryl Jones to audition and you need to call Kenny Kirkland to audition.

ctx.x: I said, “You need to call Darryl Jones to audition and you need to call Kenny Kirkland to audition. And when you do the auditions will be over because they are the best guys.
